ex.en: We sang, danced and chatted after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐後我們唱歌、跳舞、聊天。

ex.en: Just now I was chatting with my parents.
ex.zh: 剛才我在和我爸媽閒聊。

ex.en: Bob is very timid and blushes when chatting with girls.
ex.zh: 鮑伯非常膽小，和女生聊天時會臉紅。

ex.en: Tom, I want to have a chat with you.
ex.zh: 湯姆，我想跟你聊聊。

ex.en: Nancy is having a chat with her friends.
ex.zh: 南西正在跟朋友聊天。

ex.en: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
ex.zh: 你們有沒有比較便宜的房間？

ex.en: Would you know a cheap hotel in the near?
ex.zh: 您知道附近有便宜的旅館嗎？

ex.en: If I buy more, can I get them cheaper?
ex.zh: 我多買一些，可以便宜點嗎？

cheap.zh: 廉價的、品質差的；小氣的

ex.en: The bag looks cheap and won't last long.
ex.zh: 這個包看起來很廉價，用不久。

ex.en: Don't be so cheap. Leave a tip.
ex.zh: 別那麼小氣，給點小費吧。

ex.en: Here's your change. Have a nice day.
ex.zh: 這是找您的錢，祝您有美好的一天。

ex.en: Do you have change for a hundred?
ex.zh: 你有一百元的零錢可以換嗎？

ex.en: No matter what happens, I won't change my mind.
ex.zh: 不管發生什麼事，我都不會改變主意。

ex.en: The room looks different after I've changed the curtains.
ex.zh: 我換了窗簾之後，房間看起來不一樣了。

ex.en: In ten years our town will change a lot.
ex.zh: 十年後，我們的城市會改變很多。

ex.en: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
ex.zh: 科學為我們的生活帶來了許多的改變。

ex.en: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
ex.zh: 過去十年我們經歷了很多變化。

ex.en: She suffers from chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 她有慢性背痛。

ex.en: The city has a chronic shortage of housing.
ex.zh: 這座城市長期住房不足。

ex.en: The doctor was giving a patient a checkup.
ex.zh: 醫生正在幫一位病人做健康檢查。

ex.en: You should get a checkup once a year.
ex.zh: 你應該每年做一次健康檢查。

ex.en: It's a little chilly in here.
ex.zh: 這裡有點冷。

ex.en: It's a chilly morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上冷颼颼的。

ex.en: More and more married couples share household chores.
ex.zh: 越來越多夫妻一起分擔家事。

ex.en: My kids help with chores like washing dishes.
ex.zh: 我的孩子會幫忙洗碗之類的家事。

ex.en: Tom is a famous chef.
ex.zh: 湯姆是有名的廚師。

ex.en: We have a very good chef.
ex.zh: 我們有一位非常好的廚師。

ex.en: She used to be a part time chef, then she became full time.
ex.zh: 她以前是兼職廚師，後來做了全職。

ex.en: Sue checked in at the Royal Hotel.
ex.zh: 蘇在皇家飯店辦理了入住。

ex.en: He checked in at a good hotel.
ex.zh: 他入住了一間很好的旅館。

ex.en: Can I leave my bags with you until I come to check in?
ex.zh: 在我辦理入住之前，可以先把行李寄放在你這裡嗎？

ex.en: You should check in at least two hours before an international flight.
ex.zh: 搭國際航班至少要提前兩小時辦理報到。

ex.en: We checked in online, so we only had to drop off our bags.
ex.zh: 我們已經線上報到，所以只需要托運行李。

ex.en: I'm going to check out at eight.
ex.zh: 我會在八點退房。

ex.en: I'd like to check out right now.
ex.zh: 我想現在退房。

ex.en: Recently someone told me about a language website, tatoeba.org, which I will definitely check out.
ex.zh: 最近有人告訴我一個語言網站，tatoeba.org。我一定要看看。

ex.en: You should check out the new café near the station.
ex.zh: 你應該去看看車站附近那家新咖啡店。

ex.en: If you're worried, go for an endoscopy to have it checked out.
ex.zh: 要是不放心的話，你去做個胃鏡查一查。

ex.en: Get your car checked out before the long trip.
ex.zh: 長途旅行前把車子送去檢查一下。

ex.en: The workflow is illustrated in the following chart.
ex.zh: 工作流程如下圖所示。

ex.en: This chart shows our sales over the past year.
ex.zh: 這張圖表顯示我們過去一年的銷售狀況。

ex.en: Her new song is at the top of the charts.
ex.zh: 她的新歌登上排行榜冠軍。

ex.en: The album stayed on the charts for months.
ex.zh: 這張專輯在排行榜上待了好幾個月。
